map.轻量化场景单位质量承载更关键，比强度=强度÷密度，直接反映减重潜力。: In lightweighting scenarios, load capacity per unit mass matters more, and specific strength = strength / density directly reflects the weight-saving potential.
map.轻量化设计量化减重收益。: Quantify the weight-saving benefit in lightweight design.
map.：原钢件 10kg 换碳纤维件约 4kg：减重 = 10−4 = 6kg，减重率: : replacing a 10 kg steel part with a carbon fibre part of about 4 kg: weight saved = 10-4 = 6 kg, a reduction of 6/10*100 = 60%, a clear improvement in range and energy use.
map.：碳纤维密度 1.6g/cm³、抗拉 3500MPa；铝合金密度 2.7、抗拉: : carbon fibre has a density of 1.6 g/cm3 and a tensile strength of 3500 MPa; aluminium alloy has a density of 2.7 and a tensile strength of 400 MPa: the specific strength of carbon fibre ≈ 2188 far exceeds that of aluminium ≈ 148, allowing about 40% less weight at the same strength.
